The '''Ewok Lake Village''' was a [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Ewok stilt village/Legends|stilt village]] located in the [[Nub Shanda]] [[lake]], on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was inhabited by the Ewoks of the [[Gondula]] tribe. The tribe also inhabited [[Southern Ewok Lake Village|another stilt village]] in the [[Mertuen Forest]], further to the southwest.<ref name="SWG:ELV" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SouthernEwokLakeVillage.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An aerial perspective of the village]]
The Ewok Lake Village was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ELV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, there were two Ewok stilt villages and both were simply called an "Ewok Lake Village,"<ref name="SWG:ELV" /> however the game's directory tree files and source data give the more specific name of '''Gondula Ewok Lakeside Village'''.<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|directory tree files and source data}}</ref>
